_comment: USD per 1M tokens for standard paid-tier API usage. Keys are canonical model IDs as recorded in metrics. Lookup is exact, falling back to a prefix match only for pinned snapshots (-2026-01-15, -latest). Models absent from this file report cost as unknown (—) rather than $0.00. Local providers (custom/ollama) always count as free.
_schema: Each entry takes input_per_1m and output_per_1m. Optional 'long_context' {above_input_tokens, input_per_1m, output_per_1m} applies a higher tier to prompts over the threshold. Optional 'rate_change' {from: YYYY-MM-DD, ...} takes effect on that date.
_substitutions: gpt-5.1-codex is not listed on the OpenAI pricing page; it is priced here using the published gpt-5.3-codex rate as a deliberate stand-in. Revisit if OpenAI publishes a gpt-5.1-codex rate.
_notes: Gemini audio-input surcharges are not modelled; PAL sends text, so the text rate applies.
